text:
anya: ran into a weird interaction today: safetensors shard-meta cache eviction + aggressive speculative warmup caused sustained prefetch storms on a multi-tenant node.
kyle: can you summarize the storm pattern? was it many tenants requesting overlapping shards or one tenant thrashing?
anya: one tenant had a sudden traffic burst requesting varied prefixes. speculative warmup kicked in (to reduce tail latency) and started pulling entire shards. node warmed those shards, but eviction policy evicted other tenants' shard metas and caused repeated cold misses.
sophia: sounds like we lack a tenant-aware eviction/soft-reserve for shard-meta. current LRU treats all tenants equally.
trent: proposal: mark shard-meta entries with tenant_affinity + weight (hotness score) and maintain a small per-tenant soft-reserve quota. when global mem pressure happens, evict from tenants above their quota first.
anya: also add a short-lived speculative token counter: each tenant can hold N speculative warmup tokens, replenished slowly. once tokens exhausted, downgrade warmup to conservative.
kyle: example config I'd ship as a feature flag:

```
shard_meta_cache:
  total_bytes: 12GB
  per_tenant_soft_reserve: 0.05 # fraction of total
  speculative_tokens_per_tenant: 3
  token_replenish_seconds: 600
  eviction_policy: tenant_aware_lru
```

sophia: telemetry we need: speculative_token_use_count, tenant_meta_evictions, cross_tenant_eviction_rate, prefetch_fallbacks. Ops wants these before any rollout.
trent: loader change: speculative warmup should prefer prefix-level KV caching first (cheap), then incremental tensor fetches, and only use a speculative token for full-shard fetch.
anya: admin override: enterprise SLA tenants can request emergency_tokens that are billed and require explicit opt-in. docs and billing will track warmup_bytes used by emergency tokens.
kyle: small detail: when tenant_affinity present, loader should prefer to colocate shard-meta cache items in same NUMA region as that tenant's worker to reduce cross-socket mmap overhead. hardware note.
sophia: good call. we should also add an integrity check: shard-meta version fingerprint to avoid serving stale index after bundle reupload. if mismatch, invalidate tokens for that tenant and rebuild hints lazily.
warmup-bot: notice: observed speculative_token_depletion for tenant acme-inc in gpu-pool-02 at 2026-02-03T03:21Z.
anya: ok next steps: 1) implement token bucket + tenant-aware eviction in shard-meta cache 2) add metrics and alerting 3) docs + billing for emergency tokens 4) gate feature behind per-tenant flag for soft rollout. I'll open a PR with the cache patch and a short canary plan.
trent: ping me on the PR for the NUMA placement bits, and I'll add a microbenchmark.
sophia: I'll draft the dashboard panels for the telemetry set.
anya: thanks, closing the loop.
